theorem Roth.index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ}
  {k : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv k) P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ), Roth.index P α r - Roth.weight r k ≤ Roth.index ((MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv k) P) α r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {P} {k} hk α r ↦
  Exists.casesOn (Roth.exists_weight_eq_index hk α r) fun i h ↦
    And.casesOn h fun hi hiw ↦
      sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (LE.le (Roth.index P α r))
            (Eq.trans (Roth.weight_add r i k) (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd hiw) (Roth.weight r k))))
          (Roth.index_le_weight
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext mul_ne_zero_iff))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a * (MvPolynomial.eval α) ((MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv (i + k)) P) ≠ 0)
                    (MvPolynomial.eval_C ↑(MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff i (i + k))))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≠ 0)
                      (map_mul (MvPolynomial.eval α) (MvPolynomial.C ↑(MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff i (i + k)))
                        ((MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv (i + k)) P)))
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.eval α) _a ≠ 0)
                        (MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul ((MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv (i + k)) P)
                          ↑(MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff i (i + k))))
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.eval α) _a ≠ 0) (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv i k P))
                        hi))))).right))

theorem Roth.le_index_sum.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {ι : Type u_2} {s : Finset ι}
  {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ},
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 → ∀ {c : ℝ}, (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 → c ≤ Roth.index (f i) α r) → c ≤ Roth.index (∑ i ∈ s, f i) α r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {ι} {s} {f} {α} {r} hs {c} hf ↦
  (Roth.le_index_iff hs).mpr fun d hd ↦
    Exists.casesOn
      (Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≠ 0) (map_sum (MvPolynomial.eval α) (fun x ↦ (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) (f x)) s))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.eval α) _a ≠ 0) (map_sum (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) f s)) hd)))
      fun i h ↦
      And.casesOn h fun hi hid ↦
        have hfi := fun h0 ↦
          hid
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.eval α) ((MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) _a) = 0) h0))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.eval α) _a = 0) (map_zero (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d))))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 0) (map_zero (MvPolynomial.eval α)))) (Eq.refl 0))));
